seo.title: Your Company — branding and digital agency in Tashkent
seo.description: Identity, WebGL-animated websites and ad production for brands in Uzbekistan and Central Asia. Strategy, design and development — one team.
seo.answer: Your Company is a creative agency in Tashkent: brand strategy, identity, WebGL-animated websites and commercials. A branding project takes from 6 weeks and starts at $9,000; a website takes from 6 weeks and starts at $7,000.

listing.description: A website for a creative agency, design studio or production house. A dark showcase with living WebGL silk, projects as rows with a photo that follows the cursor, oversized serif type — it presents the studio as a premium brand.

sections.title: We make brands
sections.subtitle: Strategy, identity, websites and production for companies that need more than “just pretty”. One team from the first idea to launch.

sections.label: Studio
sections.title: We combine strategy, craft and technology so a brand works for the business — and is remembered from the first touch.
sections.text: Twelve people: strategists, designers, motion artists and developers. We work in small teams per project with no account managers in between — you talk to the people doing the work. In six years, more than 80 brands in retail, real estate, hospitality and tech.

items.title: Saffron Hall
items.text: Rebranding of a restaurant group: sign system, menus, a website with bookings.

items.title: Orbita Bank
items.text: A mobile banking interface and a 400-component design system.

items.title: Yalla Tea
items.text: A range of 14 teas: packaging, photography, social launch.

items.title: Kamar Residence
items.text: A residential complex website with interactive apartment selection.

items.title: Fergana Silk
items.text: An image campaign and a short film about the craft.

sections.label: Services
sections.title: What we do
sections.intro: We take on a whole project or a single stage — timing and budget come after the brief.

items.title: Brand strategy
items.text: Research, positioning, platform and tone of voice.

items.title: Identity
items.text: Logo, typefaces, colour, graphics, guidelines and applications.

items.title: Websites and WebGL
items.text: Design, animation, Next.js development, SEO and an admin panel.

items.title: Motion and production
items.text: Films, 3D, photo and video shoots for campaigns.

items.title: Brief and immersion
items.text: A meeting, team interviews, market and competitor analysis.

items.title: Strategy
items.text: We define who you are and who you are for. It is the foundation of the visuals.

items.title: Design
items.text: Two or three concepts, then one — down to the last detail.

items.title: Launch
items.text: We hand over the guidelines, files and website, and support you for the first months.

items.quote: Your Company turned scattered restaurants into one recognisable family. Guests now know us by the menu before they see the sign.
items.author: Aziz Karimov

items.quote: A rare studio where designers understand the product. They delivered a design system our team has been working with for two years now.
items.author: Elena Li

items.a: A full identity starts at $9,000, strategy on its own at $3,000. We quote the exact amount after the brief: it depends on the number of applications and the scope of research.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: Strategy takes 2–4 weeks, identity 6–10 weeks, a website 6–12 weeks. Timelines are fixed in the contract.

items.q: Do you work with companies outside Tashkent?
items.a: Yes. A third of our clients are from Kazakhstan and the UAE. Meetings are online, and we fly in for key stages.

items.q: Can we order just a website?
items.a: Yes, if you already have an identity. We do the design, animation, development, SEO and an admin panel so you can edit it yourself.
Write or call us — we will send a 15-question brief and set up a meeting within two working days.
